examples.name: Default
examples.summary: The plain editor inside a `Field`: line numbers, two-space Tab indentation (Escape then Tab leaves), and server diagnostics as `markers` painted on their lines and listed under the editor. Pass `loader: () => import('monaco-editor')` and Monaco takes over the same value and markers once it loads.
examples.sfc:
<script setup>
  import CodeEditor from '@aziontech/webkit/code-editor'
  import Field from '@aziontech/webkit/field'
  import { ref } from 'vue'

  const code = ref(`export default async function handler(request) {
  const url = new URL(request.url)
  const name = url.searchParams.get('name')
  return new Response(\`Hello, \${name}\`)
}
`)

  const markers = [
    { line: 3, severity: 'warning', message: 'name can be null; give it a default value.' },
    { line: 4, severity: 'info', message: 'Set a Content-Type header on the response.' }
  ]
</script>

<template>
  <Field>
    <Field.Label>Function code</Field.Label>
    <CodeEditor
      v-model="code"
      language="javascript"
      :markers="markers"
      height="14rem"
    />
    <Field.Description>Runs on every request that reaches this function.</Field.Description>
  </Field>
</template>

examples.name: Diff
examples.summary: `diff` with `original`: the saved version on the left (read-only) beside the edited one, side by side on a wide container and stacked on a narrow one.
examples.sfc:
<script setup>
  import CodeEditor from '@aziontech/webkit/code-editor'
  import { ref } from 'vue'

  const original = `{
  "cache": {
    "ttl": 60,
    "bypass": false
  }
}
`

  const next = ref(`{
  "cache": {
    "ttl": 300,
    "bypass": false,
    "stale": true
  }
}
`)
</script>

<template>
  <CodeEditor
    v-model="next"
    :original="original"
    language="json"
    diff
    height="12rem"
    aria-label="Cache settings"
  />
</template>

examples.name: ReadOnly
examples.summary: `readonly` code that can be read, selected and copied but not changed.
examples.sfc:
<script setup>
  import CodeEditor from '@aziontech/webkit/code-editor'

  const query = `SELECT country, count(*) AS requests
FROM events
WHERE status >= 500
GROUP BY country
ORDER BY requests DESC
LIMIT 10;
`
</script>

<template>
  <CodeEditor
    :model-value="query"
    language="sql"
    readonly
    height="10rem"
    aria-label="Saved query"
  />
</template>
